author: nflaig
content:
we've (or rather Jason) added this note now, hope that clarifies it a bit
```
 This is how the builder learns that its bid won without waiting for the
 block on gossip. The builder SHOULD help disseminate the block. The proposer
 gossips the block itself either way, regardless of the response.
```

author: vladimir_ea
content: thanks - a builder can certainly help gossip the payload - but it doesn't actually know it has 'won' until it observes a weight of attestations in favour of its block (unless it trusts the proposer)

author: nflaig
content: yeah but I think it should be still good for the builder to know whether the block was disseminated to all of nodes, and at the same time, it can help proposers with bad peering

author: vladimir_ea
content: yes understood - worth noting that most builders probably don't currently having any consensus layer peering since this is typically delegated to relays.

author: nflaig
content: but no matter if relay handles, I suspect the builder (or relay) if it has the bandwidth to do it in incentivized to even flood publish the block to as many nodes, could also help in case of proposer equivocations

author: nflaig
content: but likely a proposer that is trying to unbundle a builder won't submit it via api
